title: "Air Force Asks Reports on 'Saucers'" - Seattle Times, Feb 28, 1960 (UPI)
description: Wide newspaper clipping headlined "Air Force Asks Reports on 'Saucers'," a UPI story datelined Washington, Feb. 27, reporting that the Air Force directed its commands to treat sightings of unidentified flying objects as "serious business" directly related to national defense. It notes the directive was made public by the National Investigations Committee on Aerial Phenomena and quotes Vice Adm. R. H. Hillenkoetter (ret.), a NICAP board member and former CIA director, calling for open congressional hearings. Stamps show the Seattle Times, FEB 28 1960, page 6, column 5, and FBI file number 100-18945-77.
